name: Weekly status update writer
why: A one-page done, stuck and needed update, the same shape as the weekly status update prompt.

name: Prepare a clear client project kickoff
why: A one-page kickoff brief and action list with owners, matching the kickoff step of the goal to launch workflow.

name: Prepare a client scope change brief
why: Compares a change request with the signed scope and drafts a reply, like the change request steps in the scope skill.

name: Client scope decision review assistant
why: Keeps new work marked as proposed until the client accepts, which suits agencies running change control every week.

name: Check capacity before promising a delivery date
why: A capacity view and date options with risks before any promise, like the team capacity plan prompt.

name: Trace why work keeps missing deadlines
why: A delay map with causes from records, useful when re-planning a drifted project.

name: Weekly project delay evidence assistant
why: A weekly delay trend brief that feeds the risk check in weekly project control.

name: Launch scope halver
why: Keeps the date and halves the scope, one of the options when the critical path misses the deadline.

name: Prepare your first freelance project quote
why: Turns a website brief into a scoped quote, the supplier side of the estimate skill.

name: Domain and redirect layout planner
why: Plans the main domain and redirects, a companion to the redirect map in the website redesign skill.

name: Plan a vendor change without losing work
why: An exit checklist and staged rollout with rollback for projects that switch software or suppliers.

name: Run a project review where people tell the truth
why: A blame-free review that turns lessons into rules, the fuller version of the wrap-up review prompt.

name: Turn meetings into owned actions
why: Action lists with owners and dates from meeting notes, which keep the plan and status updates current.
